```yaml
name: E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.22'

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          rust-version: stable

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies and build Tavern frontend
        run: |
          cd tavern/frontend
          npm ci
          npm run build

      - name: Build Tavern server
        run: |
          cargo build --release --bin tavern

      - name: Start Tavern server
        run: |
          set -e
          ./target/release/tavern &
          echo $! > tavern.pid
          # Wait until the server is listening on port 8080
          until nc -z localhost 8080; do sleep 1; done
        env:
          RUST_LOG: info

      - name: Retrieve server public key
        id: get_key
        run: |
          KEY=$(curl -s http://localhost:8080/public-key)
          echo "public_key=$KEY" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Build Imixv2 agent
        run: |
          cargo build --release --bin imixv2

      - name: Start Imixv2 agent
        run: |
          set -e
          ./target/release/imixv2 --key "${{ steps.get_key.outputs.public_key }}" &
          echo $! > imixv2.pid

      - name: Install Playwright dependencies
        run: |
          cd tests/e2e
          npm ci
          npx playwright install --with-deps

      - name: Run Playwright tests
        run: |
          cd tests/e2e
          npx playwright test
        env:
          SERVER_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -f tavern.pid ]; then kill $(cat tavern.pid); fi
          if [ -f imixv2.pid ]; then kill $(cat imixv2.pid); fi
```
